entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh, that's it! That's the Persona we[n]asked for!
entries.uk: О, ось вона! Та сама Персона,[n]яку ми просили!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You really made it!?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: The inmate with all those pitiful Personas[n]actually managed this?
entries.uk: В'язень з усіма тими жалюгідними[n]Персонами таки це зробив?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hmph... I guess I can compliment you[n]this time.
entries.uk: Хм... Мабуть, цього разу можна[n]тебе й похвалити.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Well done.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You have far exceeded our original[n]expectations.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: This may not be a proper thing to say[n]to an inmate, but you have done[n]extraordinary work.
entries.uk: Можливо, в'язню таке казати не годиться,[n]але ти виконав надзвичайну[n]роботу.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You're a real handful, but I gotta give you[n]some credit.
entries.uk: З тобою стільки мороки, але мушу[n]віддати тобі належне.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: As for the next task we will assign to you...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: There is nothing.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You have fulfilled every duty available[n]to you.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: As the ones who rule over power,[n]our role is...
entries.uk: Як ті, хто владарює над силою,[n]наша роль...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Rule over... power?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Why did I say that?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Unh... A voice is echoing... in my head!
entries.uk: Угх... Голос лунає... у моїй голові!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Justine?
Are you okay?
Rule over power?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I-It is nothing. Just... my head...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Urgh! These memories... The one who[n]first wrote this list.
entries.uk: Угх! Ці спогади... Та, хто вперше[n]написала цей список.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It was me... Or was it us?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Just... what are we?
Are you okay?
Did you remember something?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: *pant* *pant*

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: My apologies...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Don't worry. This has happened[n]to me too.
entries.uk: Не переймайся. Зі мною теж[n]таке було.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Inmate! This is all your fault for not[n]keeping your mouth shut!
entries.uk: В'язню! Це все через тебе, бо ти[n]не вмієш тримати язика за зубами!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Caroline, do not shift the blame[n]onto him...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Ugh... I hope you know you're a real[n]handful, Inmate!
entries.uk: Угх... Сподіваюся, ти знаєш, скільки[n]з тобою мороки, в'язню!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: But... fine. I'll grant you that privilege.[n]Heh, we've really gone soft, huh?
entries.uk: Але... гаразд. Я надам тобі цей привілей.[n]Хех, ми й справді розм'якли, га?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Perhaps...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Perhaps you are too embarrassed[n]to admit how much his concern[n]pleased you?
entries.uk: Можливо, тобі просто соромно[n]визнати, як тебе потішила[n]його турбота?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: No!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Anyway, we're gonna give you a great[n]ability this time! You're gonna cry tears[n]of joy when you get it!
entries.uk: Хай там як, цього разу ми дамо тобі[n]чудову здібність! Плакатимеш[n]від щастя, коли отримаєш!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: And, um, Inmate...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: There's no doubt you're a problem child...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: But honestly... we're real impressed that[n]you conquered all the trials we put forth.
entries.uk: Але, чесно... нас справді вразило, що ти[n]подолав усі випробування, які ми дали.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You hold a surprisingly great potential.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: So... fight. I'm sure you'll be able to[n]accomplish anything you put your[n]mind to.
entries.uk: Тож... борися. Я певна, ти зможеш[n]досягти всього, чого[n]забажаєш.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: And you'd better put a stop to the ruin,[n]okay!?
Leave it to me.
Please support me.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Trickster... I believe in you. Prove to us[n]that you can reach the truth.
entries.uk: Трикстере... Я вірю в тебе. Доведи нам,[n]що зможеш дістатися правди.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We will be waiting for you, [fName]...
I feel a strong bond with[n]Caroline and Justine...
entries.uk: Я відчуваю міцний зв'язок[n]із Кароліною і Жюстіною...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Be careful not to lose focus.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You're still in rehabilitation till you can[n]get out from behind the bars. Got that,[n]Inmate!?
entries.uk: Ти досі на виправленні, доки не вийдеш[n]із-за ґрат. Зрозумів,[n]в'язню!?
